AL.name: Alabama
AL.tax: Military retirement fully exempt; BAH/BAS/combat pay exempt
AL.edu: Alabama NG Educational Assistance Program (ANGEAP): up to $6,017.50/semester, up to 120 credit hours; plus AL G.I. Dependents Scholarship ($400/credit hr for dependents of 40%+ rated vets)
AL.health: State veterans homes network (5 homes); ADVA county officers assist with VA healthcare enrollment
AL.burial: Alabama State Veterans Memorial Cemetery (Spanish Fort); burial fee waivers; spouse/dependent eligibility
AL.notes: Veteran hiring preference in state employment; full property-tax exemption at 100% rating or age 65+ (up to 160 acres)

GA.name: Georgia
GA.tax: $65K exemption at 65+; expanding to all ages TY2026
GA.edu: GA National Guard Service Cancelable Loan; HERO Scholarship
GA.health: State veterans homes; VECTR Center training access

FL.name: Florida
FL.edu: FL NG Education Dollars for Duty (EDD) tuition waiver
FL.burial: Multiple state veterans cemeteries; fee waivers
FL.notes: Veterans Florida flagship; in-state tuition for vets

TX.name: Texas
TX.edu: Hazlewood Act — 150 free public-college credit hours for vets/spouses/children; TX NG Tuition Assistance
TX.health: State veterans homes; VLB land/home/improvement loans

VA.name: Virginia
VA.edu: VMSDEP — education for spouses/dependents of disabled vets
VA.notes: V3 employer-certification flagship; base-embedded transition teams

NC.name: North Carolina
NC.edu: NC Scholarship for children of disabled vets
NC.notes: NC4ME flagship — 50 dedicated veteran employment specialists

SC.name: South Carolina
SC.edu: Free tuition for children of certain disabled vets

TN.name: Tennessee
TN.tax: No state income tax on wages
TN.edu: TN STRONG Act — NG tuition reimbursement
TN.burial: State veterans cemeteries (Knoxville, Memphis, Nashville, Parker's Crossroads)
TN.notes: Helmets to Hardhats and trade pipelines
